title: Psychology Facts
hook: Kids watched an adult punch a doll. Then this happened.
facts: In 1961, Albert *Bandura* showed 72 nursery children a grown-up model.
Some saw the adult *attack* an inflatable Bobo doll. Others saw calm play.
Afterwards, the first group copied the *exact* punches, kicks and words.
Kids learn by *watching*, not just by being told.
